claims.claim: Costco operates membership warehouses and e-commerce sites based on offering low prices on a limited selection of nationally-branded and private-label products, which produces high sales volumes and rapid inventory turnover.
claims.quote: We operate membership warehouses and e-commerce sites based on the concept that offering low prices on a limited selection of nationally-branded and private-label products in a wide range of categories will produce high sales volumes and rapid inventory turnover.

claims.claim: Costco operates 939 membership warehouses worldwide as of August 30, 2026.
claims.quote: At August 30, 2026, Costco operated 939 warehouses worldwide: 647 in the United States (U.S.) located in 47 states, Washington, D.C., and Puerto Rico, 115 in Canada, 43 in Mexico, 37 in Japan, 29 in the U.K., 20 in Korea, 15 in Australia, 14 in Taiwan, seven in China, five in Spain, three in France, two in Sweden, and one each in Iceland and New Zealand.

claims.claim: Costco plans to spend approximately $7,500 million on capital expenditures during fiscal 2027.
claims.quote: In 2026, we spent $6,435 on capital expenditures, and it is our current intention to spend approximately $7,500 during fiscal 2027.

claims.claim: Costco plans to open up to 33 new warehouses, including five relocations, in fiscal 2027.
claims.quote: We opened 28 new warehouses, including three relocations, in 2026, and plan to open up to 33 new warehouses, including five relocations, in 2027.
